title: useful set
text: useful set. These are made in the USA... from "imported" materials... Hmmm.. . not sure that's good, but at least they are made in the USA. They are pretty lightweight, but then you're using them in your toaster oven, not industrial cooking kitchen.  I am sure they will last for a little while.  They are coated with a "non-stick" surface of some sort.  They do NOT recommend dishwasher cleaning.  However, you should hand wash anything that has a "non-stick" coating as it will cause it to flake off eventually.  I have a pretty good size toaster oven, so these are actually dwarfed a bit in the oven, but that's ok to me.  Says they are safe to 450 degrees and says there will "never rust"  because it is aluminumized steel (?) The little rack that fits into the deeper rectangle pan is black.. I can't tell if the rack non-stick or not. I suppose you could also set the rack in the cookie sheet if you wanted to.  There is also a plastic cover (which is obviously NOT for oven use) that fits over the muffin and the deeper rectangle pan.  I am not sure why you would put it on the tiny cookie sheet, but it doesn't seem to fit over it quite as well.  An nice bonus if you were taking a small pan of cupcakes or muffins or perhaps a tiny cake for a tea party at the neighbors? They arrived quickly and in good condition ( I have prime).  I will be updating if there are any issues with wear or otherwise.

description: Compact Oven 3 pc. Grilling and Baking Set includes 7 inch x 10 inch baking sheet, casserole pan, and broiling grill. Cook, broil or bake your favorite meals or cookies in your toaster oven, outdoor gas or electric grill, camp stove or RV stove with Nordic Wares Grill & Bake set. Sized for easy storage and small spaces this set can be used for both toaster ovens or regular ovens. With the non-stick surface cooking and cleaning are a breeze. Made in USA with imported rack. Interior cooking surface dimensions of the baking sheets is 6 x 8 inches and the maximum exterior dimensions are10 x 7 x 1.9 inches.

If you crave flexible cooking tools but space is an issue, consider the Nordic Ware three-piece grilling set. Made by the company that pioneered microwave cookware and other adaptable cooking tools, this set features a portable 7-by-10-inch baking sheet, a casserole/roast pan, and a broiling grill. The products fit both toaster ovens and conventional ovens, letting you toast, grill, or bake a variety of foods in your appliance of choice. The set is especially ideal for dorms, boats, RVs, offices, and other space-limited locations where stackable products are essential. Each piece is coated with a nonstick material that makes cleanup easy and efficient.
